flows.name: Public HTML and static assets
flows.keyAuthority: TLS origin operator; not an E2EE recipient
flows.metadata: Client IP, request URL, timing visible to hosting and network operators
flows.applicability: Public informational content; no end-to-end recipient-private payload

flows.name: Initiative public API GET
flows.keyAuthority: TLS origin operator; no confidential recipient keys
flows.metadata: Client IP, initiative slug and request timestamps visible
flows.applicability: Only enumerated initiative summary fields are public. Not a private E2EE flow.

flows.name: Process liveness and DB readiness
flows.destination: core API then optional core DB
flows.metadata: Health status, response timestamps and requester IP visible
flows.applicability: Minimal health information; DB connection uses transport controls and is not E2EE

flows.name: Core database: initiatives, public CMS and private metadata
flows.keyAuthority: Database/operator for SQL access; app-level field keys not provisioned
flows.metadata: Schema, query metadata, DB traffic and client principal visible to hosting provider
flows.applicability: Restricted identity and contact tables exist but no production private writing or E2EE policy is implemented; encryption at rest is not E2EE

flows.name: Public CMS authoring, reviewer separation and publication
flows.keyAuthority: CMS service operator, draft reviewer and account provider TBD
flows.metadata: Editor identity, draft titles, review timestamps and revisions may be visible
flows.applicability: Draft content protected from unauthorized readers; E2E recipient model not selected. No web admin currently exposed.

flows.name: Identity recovery and subscription contact preferences
flows.keyAuthority: User/auth provider and application contact encryption keys TBD
flows.metadata: Account and email correlation, messages and provider records may be visible
flows.applicability: Need authenticated client protection and cryptographic recipient/control specification. Not equivalent to HTTPS.

flows.name: Confidential testimony, evidence and case referral
flows.keyAuthority: Specialized intake recipients and verification authority not approved
flows.metadata: Source IP, receipt, timing, case relationship and file metadata may identify reporters
flows.applicability: No production E2EE capability or end-to-end security claim. Must not accept through generic core website.

flows.name: Cross-service signed event delivery
flows.metadata: Cross-service event patterns, sender identities, volumes visible
flows.applicability: Signed events/transport integrity do not imply private-content E2EE. Exclude sensitive payloads by schema.

flows.name: FOIA/public-registry approved read-only projections
flows.keyAuthority: Public source provenance/signature authority to verify
flows.metadata: Queries and source interests visible to website and source host
flows.applicability: Public publication flow; provenance, withdrawal and authentic source matter more than content secrecy.

flows.name: Liberty Nodes public replica publication
flows.keyAuthority: Public artifact signer TBD; replicas retain copies independently
flows.metadata: Content URLs, replica geography, publication timing and request patterns visible
flows.applicability: Public immutable/distributed material is not confidential E2EE. Irreversible distribution and withdrawal limitations must be disclosed.

flows.name: Development GitHub and artifact supply chain
flows.keyAuthority: GitHub Actions service identities; release signing not implemented
flows.metadata: Repo names, PRs, timing and build logs visible to providers
flows.applicability: Software provenance is not user E2EE. No production artifact attestation/certification issued.

threats.scenario: Access to private profiles, contacts, draft content or case details through broken object- or field-level authorization
controls: deny-by-default auth in every private handler
negative tests for all cross-role/object transitions
threats.currentMitigation: Public endpoint returns only allowlisted DTO; private routes remain disabled
threats.remainingRisk: Authentication/authorization and identity have not been implemented

threats.actor: Compromised application host, provider principal or secret
threats.scenario: Exfiltration, tampering, or disclosure of contact data and operational keys
threats.currentMitigation: Private intake inactive, secrets not in repository; DB URL validation
threats.remainingRisk: Hosted KMS, encrypted contacts and infrastructure not implemented

threats.scenario: Unapproved publication, audit deletion or quiet replacement of records
threats.currentMitigation: Postgres audit and revision metadata constrained append-only; public views gated
threats.remainingRisk: Staff account controls and operational review not yet implemented

threats.actor: Harasser, surveillance observer or subpoena requester
threats.scenario: Identification, intimidation or targeting of sources through traffic metadata, file EXIF, replicated content or provider access
controls: strip metadata in approved media workflows
threats.currentMitigation: No core confidential intake or distributed republication
threats.remainingRisk: No assertion of anonymity against endpoints, providers, device compromise, legal process or traffic correlation

threats.scenario: Spoofed source, changed archive output, misleading status or cached withdrawn allegations
threats.currentMitigation: Initiatives carry informational planning status, no fetched documents
threats.remainingRisk: Adapters and cache withdrawal reconciliation not implemented

threats.actor: Remote traffic attacker or software supply chain adversary
threats.scenario: DoS, SSRF, dependency compromise, action credential theft and repository poisoning
threats.currentMitigation: Frozen lockfile, package audit, CI checks and restricted GitHub Actions permissions
threats.remainingRisk: No runtime perimeter, SBOM provenance/alerts or verified pen test

threats.actor: Buggy upstream partner or malicious publisher
threats.scenario: An allegedly approved private artifact is published or replicated without valid consent and redaction
threats.currentMitigation: Integrations disabled and generic testimony route absent
threats.remainingRisk: No production-grade publication approval service or distributed retention process

threats.actor: Credential harvester, account recovery adversary, or sender with mailing privileges
threats.scenario: Compromised accounts, unsolicited political contact, unauthorized marketing or enrollment of minors
threats.currentMitigation: No account, mailing signup or promotional contact capability enabled
threats.remainingRisk: Auth and opt-in flows are planned, not built
